newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cont Mariner confirms water supply deal.
newsitem.headline: Cont Mariner confirms water supply deal.

text.p: Continental Mariner Investment Co Ltd said it has formed a joint venture with the Water Authority of Fuyang in China's Zhejiang province to provide water supplies to the general public.
The 20-year joint venture company will be formed with a total investment of US$17.5 million, of which US$8.0 million is the registered capital, the company said in a statement.

The US$8.0 million will be injected in three instalments of US$3.68 million, US$2.00 million and US$2.32 million, payable within one, three and six months after the JV company receives its business licence, the statement said.

The registered capital of the JV company is to be paid 54 percent by the JV partner by injection of its existing water processing facilities, and 46 percent by Continental Mariner's wholly-owned Fortune Port Profits Ltd in cash, it said.

The company intends to finance its portion from internal resources and estimates an average annual return of about 15 percent and an internal rate of return of approximately 14.15 percent per annum, as well as a respectable recurring cash flow to the company, it said.
The statement gave no other details on the water supply facilities.
